thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're prepping a staged burst for EU-West-2 tied to the Q2 campaign. Need to request quota + headroom for the Dedicated GPU pool. Outline below, looking for sign-off and someone to open cloud tickets:

alex: Requested increases (rough):
- A100 instances: current 24 -> request 60
- ENIs: current 250 -> request 600
- VPC IPs (per-subnet): current 800 -> request 2000
- Warm-pool reservation: 5 x a100-similar nodes for instant burst
- Targeted timeline: ramp starting 2026-05-10, sustained bursts for 2 weeks

alex: Ballpark cost impact: additional reserved/dedicated infra ~ $70k/month if fully committed; spot-backed warm pool ~ $12k/month. Need finance confirmation but we need quotas in place by end of April to be safe.

leo: Thanks — can you add current usage per-account? also which AZs in eu-west-2? we should spread across a and b at least.

alex: Current account quotas are per-org: A100 limit 24 (all in eu-west-2a/b), ENIs 250, IPs 800. We'll target eu-west-2a & 2b primarily, fallback to 2c for excess.

sam: Suggestion: request A100 instance quota + a single higher vCPU quota so we can launch helper nodes for autoscaler. Also ask for a soft increase for p4d as fallback if A100 headroom denied.

irene: From budget side — don't commit to reserved unless engineering confirms we need sustained baseline. If bursts are short, prefer spot + warm-pool. Can infra produce cheaper vs reserved cost estimate?

quota-bot: quick-estimate: warm-pool (5 nodes spot) ~= $9k/mo, reserved 5 nodes (1yr) ~= $54k/yr. Full scale (60 A100) on-demand peak ~= $120k/mo. (These are rough.)

alex: thanks. I'll include both options in the support case. Draft support case body below — please flag missing bits before I submit:

```
Summary: Request quota increases for eu-west-2 to support short-term marketing-driven burst (start 2026-05-10).
Details:
- Increase A100 instance quota from 24 to 60 for account X (org-id: REDWOOD-123).
- Increase ENI quota from 250 to 600.
- Increase VPC IPs per-subnet from 800 to 2000.
- Request guidance for pre-warming / warm-pool reservations and any marketplace limits.
- Request expedited handling (business impact: customer-facing downtime risk if not available for campaign).
Attachments: workload profile, expected QPS, avg seq length, cost estimate.
Contact: alex@redwood.com / leo@redwood.com
```

alex: Who can file the AWS/GCP support cases? I'd like it opened today so we have 3–4 weeks for approvals.

leo: I can open the provider tickets. Will use the template above. I will request priority and include fallback ask for p4d and accelerated instances.

sam: Ops notes — when scaling up, autoscaler should prefer warm pool nodes, set draining grace to 300s for model loads, and pre-cache KV entries. Also set scaling policies to keep a 10% spare capacity margin.

irene: +1 on margin. Also please add a cost cap alert to Console so Finance gets notified at $X usage.

leo: Filing now. I'll paste support case number when done. ETA for provider response depends but we'll request 5 business day SLA.

quota-bot: ticket-created: PROVIDER-987654321 — priority: high — submitted by leo — waiting on provider reply.

alex: Awesome, thanks. Once provider confirms, can we run a quick smoke test plan? I'll draft a checklist: launch warm pool -> run small throughput test -> validate latencies under 150ms p90 -> promote to canary traffic.

sam: Sounds good. Add step to validate ENI and subnet IP exhaustion scenarios in staging (simulate scale by launching dummy pods).

leo: provider replied: asked for justification docs + architecture diagram. They've provisionally approved ENI increase to 500, asked to re-evaluate A100 numbers. Next update in 48h.
